title: 两个 Γ 形网络的级联
statement: 图示二端口由两个 Γ 形网络级联而成。N_1 由串联电阻 R_1 = 2 Ω 和并联电阻 R_2 = 4 Ω 组成；N_2 由串联电阻 R_3 = 1 Ω 和并联电阻 R_4 = 2 Ω 组成。
先分别写出 N_1、N_2 的 T 参数矩阵。再用级联公式 T = T_1·T_2，求整个二端口的 A、B、C、D。T 参数方程为 v_1 = A·v_2 − B·i_2，i_1 = C·v_2 − D·i_2，i_2 从 2 端流入。
hints: 串联阻抗 Z 的 T 矩阵是 [1 Z; 0 1]，并联导纳 Y 的 T 矩阵是 [1 0; Y 1]。Γ 形网络（先串后并）T = [1 + ZY  Z; Y  1]。
级联时前一级的输出电流 −i_2 正好是后一级的输入电流，所以 T = T_1·T_2——注意矩阵乘法的顺序不能交换。
solution: **注意：** T_2·T_1 ≠ T_1·T_2——把两级的次序对调就是另一个二端口。

en.title: Cascade of two L sections
statement: The two-port is a cascade of two L sections. N_1 has a series resistor R_1 = 2 Ω and a shunt resistor R_2 = 4 Ω; N_2 has a series resistor R_3 = 1 Ω and a shunt resistor R_4 = 2 Ω.

Write the transmission (ABCD) matrices of N_1 and N_2. Then use T = T_1·T_2 for a cascade to find A, B, C, D of the whole two-port. The equations are v_1 = A·v_2 − B·i_2, i_1 = C·v_2 − D·i_2, with i_2 flowing into terminal 2.

questions.explain: D = 0.25 × 1 + 1 × 1 = 1.25. Check AD − BC = 4.0625 − 3.0625 = 1 ✓ (the cascade is still reciprocal).

hints: A series impedance Z has the ABCD matrix [1 Z; 0 1], a shunt admittance Y has [1 0; Y 1]. An L section (series then shunt) has T = [1 + ZY  Z; Y  1].
In a cascade the output current −i_2 of the first stage is exactly the input current of the second, so T = T_1·T_2 — the order of the matrix product matters.
solution: **4. Check:** AD − BC = 3.25 × 1.25 − 3.5 × 0.875 = 1 ✓. Directly from the definition: with port 2 open and v_2 = 1 V, R_4 carries 0.5 A, the middle node is at 1.5 V, R_2 carries 0.375 A, i_1 = 0.875 A and v_1 = 1.5 + 2 × 0.875 = 3.25 V, matching A and C.
**Note:** T_2·T_1 ≠ T_1·T_2 — swapping the two stages gives a different two-port.
